lines.zh: 我这身板比家猪大两圈。
lines.en: I stand two sizes bigger than a farm pig.

lines.zh: 獠牙向前翘着，走路也蹭地。
lines.en: My tusks jut forward and graze the ground.

lines.zh: 一群猪挤在一起，我走在边上。
lines.en: The herd bunches up; I walk the edge.

lines.zh: 拱开的土从鼻子底下翻出来。
lines.en: The soil turns up from under my snout.
I walk and sniff, hunting mushrooms.
The red mushrooms smell the strongest.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩进落叶里，声音很闷。
lines.en: My hooves sink into leaves with a dull sound.
It is cold in this wood; my coat is thick.

lines.zh: 我一步一拱，路就出来了。
lines.en: A step and a root, and a path appears.

lines.zh: 同伴在叫我，我应了一声。
lines.en: A herd-mate calls and I grunt back.
A dead branch snaps in two against me.
I walk slowly, and my temper is quick.
My breath puffs out white.
This wood belongs to the herd.
Whoever stands on the path gets pushed.
There are tusk marks on the bark.
I rub my back against a trunk.
Grass hangs on my tusks.
I lift a hind leg and scrape the ground.
When the wood quiets, I stare.

lines.zh: 我在听是不是有人来了。
lines.en: I am listening for someone coming.
The smell of red mushrooms lingers.
Head down, my back hair bristles.

lines.zh: 旁边的猪靠过来，我哼了一声。
lines.en: A sow leans in and I grunt.
I have rooted up every inch here.
My belly is not full yet.
A branch snaps somewhere.
I lift my snout a little.
I am grinding my tusks; hear it?
I raise my head, tusks toward you.

lines.zh: 你在闻我们这一群的味道。
lines.en: You are sniffing at the herd.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人靠这么近。
lines.en: I do not like anyone this near.
Keep your hands away from me.
My hoof scrapes the ground once.
My bristles rise in a line.
I stare at you without blinking.
What distance are you measuring?
One step more and we will find out.
I bellow and the wood shakes.
That one hit hide.
I turn half around, tusks out.
Blood drips from my snout.
Half a step back, hoof pawing.
Hide too thick; that was a scratch.
My breath comes out in white puffs.
This wound only angers me more.

lines.zh: 我低着头，声音在喉咙里。
lines.en: My head is low, sound in my throat.
I snort and paw the ground.
Mushrooms. Give them here.
Red ones smell better than brown.
Where did you find those?
I rooted all day and found none.
Drop them on the ground; I will eat.
My tusk could serve as a blade.
These tusks can be made into a blade.
I eat badly; do not mind me.
I know the smell of red mushrooms.
This is the best thing today.
You hit nothing but meat.
I did not shift.
My tusk grazes your leg.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我獠牙旁边。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit beside my tusks.
You got lucky there.
I gave you a shove.
The path in this wood is narrow.
Get behind the tree.
I lower my head and barge through.
My coat rubbed your leg.
The herd's business is not yours.
This season I think only of eating.
There are other boars in this wood.
You want to ask about that?
I grunt twice.
Ask elsewhere in the herd.
This need not be discussed here.
Step away.

lines.zh: 獠牙长出来，不是给人看的。
lines.en: These tusks aren't for show.
Stop asking me.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我用鼻子拱。
lines.en: I root at what fell on the ground.

lines.zh: 这颗獠牙，是我自己磨的。
lines.en: I ground this tusk on my own.
I bite it and drag it aside.
Can this be eaten?
I like the earthy smell of mushrooms.
Not good, but not wasted.
You want it? Take it.

lines.zh: 我把它拱到树根下埋着。
lines.en: I root it under a tree root for later.
Something else fell there.
Things always fall in this wood.
You have a smell I do not like.
My back hair is all standing.
I turn half a circle toward you.

lines.zh: 獠牙低下来对着你的腿。
lines.en: My tusks drop level with your legs.
The herd has scattered.
That suits me better.
Take one more step forward.
Just one.

lines.zh: 你的影子压在我的鼻子上。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my snout.
My hooves have started to move.

lines.zh: 这一片林子现在很安静。
lines.en: This wood has gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里喷出一口白气。
lines.en: A puff of white leaves my snout.
I watch you and slowly turn side-on.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子一下一下刨土。
lines.en: My hoof paws the dirt again and again.
You retreat and I walk along.
I do not run; I push.
There is a tree at your back.
My herd is behind that tree.
I understand your movements.
Raise your hand and I will lower my head.
I work around to your lee side.
The soil is loose; it will carry me fast.
Your knees are trembling.
I drop my hooves a little lower.
I lower my head and drive at your legs.
My tusks scoop upward.
That knocked you to your knees.
I follow through with another shove.
Your clothes snag on my tusk.
I gore it in the flank.
That will leave a mark.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，鼻子还在喷气。
lines.en: I back half a step, still snorting.
I root at your ankle.
This one comes from my left.
I push out through the brush.
My hooves land first.
There are mushrooms here.
A few more follow behind me.
I am the biggest of this herd.

lines.zh: 鼻子一动，我就知道这地方好。
lines.en: One sniff and I know this is good ground.
The ground by the roots is worth rooting.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: I grunt once by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 我这对獠牙，能当武器使。
lines.en: These tusks of mine can be a weapon.
I do not intend to give up ground.

lines.zh: 火燎到鬃毛，我打了个滚。
lines.en: Fire catches my mane; I roll over.

lines.zh: 我摔在坡下，肚子先着地。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and land on my belly.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进耳朵，我往上顶。
lines.en: Mud fills my ears; I push upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得翻了半圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me half over.
An arrow buries in my shoulder.
That light stiffens me all over.
Too hungry to root with any force.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我全身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I shudder.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没了，我直接掉下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I drop.
